description: Hull exterior as in the no-lift print, without its islands (CHANGELOG 2026-10-14, band lift v2): the built-in rotation field (MAX_OVERHANG 30, so the hull's layer lines are the no-lift ones: deformed heights identical more than 1.5 mm from the pits), and the pits over the bulwark rims filled with the band lift (LIFT_MODE band: the layer lines around continued across the pit, no closed rings) at a gentle slope (ISLAND_LIFT_SLOPE 0.1). Vs the built-in defaults: hull layer_turns 538 -> 386 (no lift 384); hull-side islands gone. Left: a ~12-22 mm top-skin patch over sparse infill at the stern (part frame x 23, z 42), in every MAX_OVERHANG 30 print including no lift; MAX_OVERHANG 25 shrinks it to 2.5 mm but changes the whole hull's field.
